text:
The exact list of objectives, as taken from the Project's application, is as follows:
a. To eliminate land uses which are economically, socially, and naturally undesirable in flood plain areas.
b. To change flood plain land use and circulation patterns in such manner as to minimize potential losses to life and property.
c. To remove flood damaged structures that have become unsafe for occupancy; to redevelop such parcels in accord with sound flood plain and renewal planning.
d. To restore rights of ways, public facilities, utilities, and storm drainage systems damaged by flooding.
e. To provide for decreased densities among residential and other land uses which might be subjected to future flooding.
f. To retain and rehabilitate those residential structures and groupings which experienced minimal flood damage and which are in areas appropriate for residential use.
g. To modernize essential neighborhood services and facilities consistent with area residents needs, including traffic control, parking, utilities, open space, and recreation, and shopping. 
1. To provide such services within safe and convenient walking distance of every dwelling within the project area.
h. To conserve the social fabric of the project area through provision of new and rehabilitated dwellings consistent with area residents' needs and means.
i. To maximize the project area's natural advantages, including river front access, and the visual potential of street spaces through skillful site planning, landscaping, architectural, and engineering design.
